intro.story: The villagers grow fruit for the King. Today they need our help to count the fruit!
intro.goal: Solve 3 counting challenges to earn the first Crystal Shard.

challenges.prompt: 2 apples and 1 apple — how many apples together?
hints: First count the apples in the first basket, then add the apples in the second basket!
Step by step: one, two apples... and one more apple. Count them all: one, two, three!

feedback.success: Excellent! Two plus one equals three!
feedback.retry: Try again! Count the apples with me!

challenges.prompt: 3 bananas and 2 bananas — how many bananas together?
hints: Count the bananas in the first group: one, two, three. Then keep counting the second group!
Step by step: one, two, three bananas... then four, five! Five bananas!

feedback.success: Excellent! Three plus two equals five!
feedback.retry: Try again! Count the bananas with me!

challenges.prompt: 4 apples and 3 apples — how many apples together?
hints: Count the first group of apples, then keep counting while you look at the second group!
Step by step: one, two, three, four apples... then five, six, seven! Seven apples!

feedback.success: Amazing! Four plus three equals seven!
feedback.retry: Try again! Count the apples with me!

challenges.prompt: Count the mountain stars carefully! How many stars are there?
hints: Count row by row from top to bottom.
There are two rows of 5 stars plus 2 more: 12 stars!

feedback.success: Great counting! There are 12 mountain stars!
feedback.retry: Take your time and count each star one by one!

challenges.prompt: Find the number with 3 tens and 5 ones!

media.subtitle: Place Value
media.scenario: A mountain chest holds 3 bags of 10 coins and 5 loose coins. What is the total?

hints: 3 bags of 10 coins make 30.
30 plus 5 more coins equals 35!

feedback.success: Spot on! 3 tens and 5 ones equals 35!
feedback.retry: Remember tens go on the left and ones go on the right!

challenges.prompt: What time will the mountain clock show in 2 hours?

media.subtitle: Mountain Clock
media.scenario: The clock shows 3:00 right now. What time will it be 2 hours later?

hints: Count forward 2 hours from 3 o'clock.
3:00 plus 1 hour is 4:00, plus 1 more hour is 5:00!

feedback.success: Right on time! Two hours after 3:00 is 5:00!
feedback.retry: Count forward 2 hours from 3:00!

ilos.text: Understand that adding means combining two groups and counting all of them.
ilos.kidText: I can put two groups together and count them all!

ilos.text: Recall sums within 10 with objects, then without.
ilos.kidText: I can add small numbers all by myself!

ilos.text: Apply counting objects one by one to find how many (up to 10).
ilos.kidText: I can count things one by one!

intro.story: The garden animals lost their name cards. Help them find the right cards!
intro.goal: Find the right picture in 3 rounds to earn the second Crystal Shard.

challenges.prompt: Find the Cat!
hints: Look at each picture. Which one says meow and has whiskers?
Step by step: the cat has pointy ears, whiskers and a long tail. Tap the cat!

feedback.success: Great job! This is the CAT! Cat!
feedback.retry: Not that one! Listen again: find the cat!

challenges.prompt: Find the Dog!
hints: Look at each picture. Which one barks and wags its tail?
Step by step: the dog has floppy ears and wags its tail. Tap the dog!

feedback.success: Great job! This is the DOG! Dog!
feedback.retry: Not that one! Listen again: find the dog!

challenges.prompt: Find the RED one!
hints: Red is the color of apples and strawberries. Which ball is red?
Step by step: red looks like fire and like an apple. Tap the red ball!

feedback.success: Great job! This is RED! Red!
feedback.retry: Not that one! Listen again: find the red one!

challenges.prompt: Which word starts with the same 'tr' blend as TREE?

media.subtitle: Phonics
media.scenario: Say TREE out loud. Which word begins with the same 'tr' sound?

hints: Listen to the first two letters: T-R.
TR-ee and TR-ain both start with 'tr'!

feedback.success: Great ear! TREE and TRAIN share the 'tr' sound!
feedback.retry: Say each word aloud and listen to the starting blend!

challenges.prompt: Which word rhymes with STAR?

media.subtitle: Rhyme Time
media.scenario: Words that rhyme have the same ending sound. Which word rhymes with STAR?

hints: Listen to the '-ar' ending in STAR.
ST-ar and C-ar end with the same sound!

feedback.success: Spot on! STAR and CAR rhyme!
feedback.retry: Say STAR with each option to hear the matching ending!

challenges.prompt: Which word means almost the same as BIG?

media.subtitle: Word Twins
media.scenario: Synonyms are words with similar meanings. Which word is a synonym for BIG?

hints: Think of a word that describes a giant castle or house.
LARGE means big in size!

feedback.success: Wonderful! BIG and LARGE are synonyms!
feedback.retry: Watch out for opposites like TINY; pick the word that means BIG!

ilos.text: Recognise common English words by their sound, picture and written form.
ilos.kidText: I can find the word when I hear it!

ilos.text: Identify color words (red, blue, green, yellow) and match them to objects.
ilos.kidText: I know my color words!

intro.story: The magic bridge to the castle is broken. It opens only when number triples are connected!
intro.goal: Connect each number, picture and word to rebuild the bridge.

challenges.prompt: Match each garden animal picture with its name card!
hints: Flip two cards and remember where each animal and word sits.
Match the cat picture to CAT, dog to DOG, and bird to BIRD!

feedback.success: Sharp memory! You matched all garden animal pairs!
feedback.retry: Remember the cards you saw and try another pair!

challenges.prompt: Match every digit card with its number word!
hints: Watch for both numbers and number words.
Pair 1 with ONE, 2 with TWO, 3 with THREE, and 4 with FOUR!

feedback.success: Brilliant! Every number matched its word!
feedback.retry: Try remembering one pair at a time!

challenges.prompt: Match the opposite word pairs in the garden!
hints: Think of opposites: HOT goes with COLD.
Match HOT/COLD, BIG/SMALL, and DAY/NIGHT!

feedback.success: Wonderful! All opposite pairs matched!
feedback.retry: Look for the word with the opposite meaning!

challenges.prompt: Connect the number, the picture and the word!
hints: Tap the number card, then tap the picture with three things on it!
Step by step: find the number 3. Now find the picture with 3 apples. The word THREE matches them!

feedback.success: Wonderful! 3, three apples, THREE — they match! The bridge grows!
feedback.retry: Start with the number card, then find its picture and its word!

challenges.prompt: Match every number with its picture and word!
hints: Tap the number card, then tap the picture with five things on it!
Step by step: find the number 5. Now find the picture with 5 stars. The word FIVE matches them!

feedback.success: Wonderful! 5, five stars, FIVE — they match! The bridge grows!
feedback.retry: Start with the number card, then find its picture and its word!

challenges.prompt: Connect them all — number, picture and word — to grow the bridge!
hints: Tap the number card, then tap the picture with two things on it!
Step by step: find the number 2. Now find the picture with 2 balls. The word TWO matches them!

feedback.success: Wonderful! 2, two balls, TWO — they match! The bridge grows!
feedback.retry: Start with the number card, then find its picture and its word!

ilos.text: Understand that numerals, picture quantities and number words show the same amount.
ilos.kidText: Three, 3 and three apples all mean the same!

ilos.text: Recall where hidden pairs are after the cards are covered again.
ilos.kidText: I can remember where things are hiding!

intro.story: The castle cook gave food to the animals. Now the King needs to know how much is left!
intro.goal: Subtract to find what is left in 3 rounds.

challenges.prompt: Count the total sides of a triangle and a square!

media.subtitle: Shape Count
media.scenario: A triangle has 3 straight sides and a square has 4 straight sides. How many sides altogether?

hints: Add the 3 triangle sides and 4 square sides.
3 plus 4 equals 7 sides!

feedback.success: Correct! 3 + 4 = 7 sides in total!
feedback.retry: Count 3 sides, then add 4 more!

challenges.prompt: What number comes next in the skip-counting pattern?

media.subtitle: Pattern Path
media.scenario: Look at how each number grows along the stones. Which number replaces '?'?

hints: Each step adds 2 to the previous number.
8 plus 2 equals 10!

feedback.success: Great pattern sense! 2, 4, 6, 8, 10!
feedback.retry: Check how much is added at every step!

challenges.prompt: Use the clues to find who finished FIRST!

media.subtitle: First Logic
media.scenario: Three friends ran across Learning Island:
clues: Sam crossed the bridge before Mia.
Leo crossed the bridge after Mia.
Who finished FIRST?

hints: Put Sam ahead of Mia, and Leo behind Mia.
The order is Sam, Mia, Leo - so Sam was first!

feedback.success: Logical thinking! Sam finished first!
feedback.retry: Line up the three names from first to last!

challenges.prompt: 8 apples were here. 3 apples were given away. How many apples are left?
hints: Start with 8 apples, then take 3 away one by one.
Step by step: 8 apples... take 1 away (7)... keep taking: 5 apples are left!

feedback.success: Excellent! Eight minus three equals five!
feedback.retry: Try again! Watch the apples disappear and count with me!

challenges.prompt: 9 apples were here. 4 apples were given away. How many apples are left?
hints: Start with 9 apples, then take 4 away one by one.
Step by step: 9 apples... take 1 away (8), take another (7), keep going: 5 are left!

feedback.success: Excellent! Nine minus four equals five!
feedback.retry: Try again! Watch the apples disappear and count with me!

challenges.prompt: 10 apples were here. 6 apples were given away. How many apples are left?
hints: Start with 10 apples, then take 6 away one by one.
Step by step: 10 apples... take 1 away (9)... keep taking: 4 are left!

feedback.success: Excellent! Ten minus six equals four!
feedback.retry: Try again! Watch the apples disappear and count with me!

ilos.text: Understand subtraction as taking away objects and counting what is left.
ilos.kidText: I can take away and see what is left!

ilos.text: Recall subtraction facts within 10.
ilos.kidText: I know take-away answers super fast!

ilos.text: Apply two-step problems: finish one operation, then use its result in the next.
ilos.kidText: I can do one sum, then another, and finish the quest!

intro.story: Letters flew off the pages of the magic books! Put them back in order.
intro.goal: Spell 3 words to fix the magic books.

challenges.prompt: Copy the glowing Gold Frame onto your canvas!
hints: Pick yellow or red from Colors, then tap squares to match Goal.
Copy row by row: outer gold ring with two red squares in row 2!

feedback.success: Beautiful pixel art! Your copy matches the Goal!
feedback.retry: Check the glowing squares against the Goal grid!

challenges.prompt: Mirror the left side across the center line!
hints: Column 3 mirrors Column 2, and Column 4 mirrors Column 1.
Row 1 becomes teal, orange, orange, teal - mirror every row!

feedback.success: Perfect mirror symmetry!
feedback.retry: Check the glowing squares to make left and right match as mirrors!

challenges.prompt: Continue the checkerboard tile pattern!
hints: Colors alternate purple-yellow-purple-yellow across rows and columns.
No two touching squares share the same color!

feedback.success: Awesome checkerboard! Pattern complete!
feedback.retry: Check the glowing squares so purple and yellow always alternate!

challenges.prompt: The word is CAT! Drag the letters in the right order!
hints: Look at the picture and say the word slowly. Which letter comes first?
Step by step: the word CAT starts with C! Then A, then T. Drag: C-A-T!

feedback.success: Amazing! C-A-T spells CAT!
feedback.retry: Almost! Say CAT slowly and find the first letter C!

challenges.prompt: The word is SUN! Drag the letters in the right order!
hints: Look at the picture and say the word slowly. Which letter comes first?
Step by step: the word SUN starts with S! Then U, then N. Drag: S-U-N!

feedback.success: Amazing! S-U-N spells SUN!
feedback.retry: Almost! Say SUN slowly and start with the letter S!

challenges.prompt: The word is DOG! Drag the letters in the right order!
hints: Look at the picture and say the word slowly. Which letter comes first?
Step by step: the word DOG starts with D! Then O, then G. Drag: D-O-G!

feedback.success: Amazing! D-O-G spells DOG!
feedback.retry: Almost! Say DOG slowly and start with the letter D!

ilos.text: Construct a target word by placing its letters in the correct order.
ilos.kidText: I can build words letter by letter!

ilos.text: Produce a picture on a pixel grid by naming colors and copying square by square.
ilos.kidText: I can paint a picture on a tiny grid!

intro.story: Princess Lexi needs a magic potion with exact ingredients.
intro.goal: Add the right stars to the cauldron and find the total.

challenges.prompt: What stage comes between a sprout and a full tree?

media.subtitle: Life Cycle
media.scenario: Follow the plant life cycle in order. Which stage fills the '?' slot?

hints: After a tiny sprout grows leaves, it becomes a small growing plant.
Seed -> Sprout -> Young plant -> Full Tree!

feedback.success: Great science! A sprout grows into a young plant!
feedback.retry: Look at the order from tiny seed to big tree!

challenges.prompt: Match each living thing with its natural habitat!
hints: Think where each living thing lives.
Fish -> Ocean Reef, Bird -> Forest Canopy, Tree -> Sunny Meadow!

feedback.success: Great habitat matching! Every organism is home!
feedback.retry: Connect each creature or plant to where it thrives!

challenges.prompt: What happens when liquid water freezes in the cold lab?

media.subtitle: Matter Change
media.scenario: We cool liquid water below 0 degrees Celsius. What state does it become?

hints: Think about an ice cube tray in a freezer.
Frozen water turns into solid ice!

feedback.success: Correct! Cooling water below freezing turns it into solid ice!
feedback.retry: Remember what happens to water inside a freezer!

challenges.prompt: Add 2 red stars and 3 blue stars to the cauldron!
hints: Tap the red star button 2 times, then the blue star button 3 times!
Step by step: red, red... then blue, blue, blue. Count them all: one, two, three, four, five!

feedback.success: Perfect potion! 2 red and 3 blue stars make 5!
feedback.retry: Hmm, that's not the right total! Count with me again!

challenges.prompt: Add 4 green stars and 1 yellow star to the cauldron!
hints: Tap the green star button 4 times, then the yellow star button 1 time!
Step by step: green, green, green, green... then yellow. Count them all: one to five!

feedback.success: Perfect potion! 4 green and 1 yellow star make 5!
feedback.retry: Hmm, that's not the right total! Count with me again!

challenges.prompt: Put 6 stars in, then take 2 stars out!
hints: First tap the star button 6 times, then tap 2 stars inside the cauldron to remove them!
Step by step: 6 stars in... take 1 out (5)... take 1 out (4). 4 stars are left!

feedback.success: Perfect potion! 6 minus 2 equals 4!
feedback.retry: Hmm, that's not the right total! Count with me again!

ilos.text: Apply adding and taking away to reach an exact total of potion ingredients.
ilos.kidText: I can add and remove to get the right number!

ilos.text: Classify ingredients by color and count each colored group.
ilos.kidText: I can sort by color and count!

intro.story: Each mountain gate opens with a secret number. Climb with the number line!
intro.goal: Move along the number line to open 3 gates.

challenges.prompt: Which clouds bring steady rain across Sky Kingdom?

media.subtitle: Cloud Watch
media.scenario: Thick, dark gray clouds blanket the whole sky right before steady rain falls. What are rain-bearing clouds called?

hints: 'Nimbus' means rain cloud in Latin.
Nimbus clouds carry heavy water droplets for rain!

feedback.success: Right! Nimbus clouds bring steady rain!
feedback.retry: Look for the scientific cloud name!

challenges.prompt: Why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?

media.subtitle: Storm Science
media.scenario: Lightning flashes in the sky and thunder booms a few seconds later. Why does the flash arrive first?

hints: Both happen at the same instant, so compare speed.
Light races much faster through air than sound waves!

feedback.success: Brilliant! Light reaches your eyes far faster than sound reaches your ears!
feedback.retry: Compare how fast light travels versus how fast sound travels!

challenges.prompt: What two ingredients create a rainbow in the sky?

media.subtitle: Sky Magic
media.scenario: Complete the rainbow recipe in Sky Kingdom:

hints: Sunlight bends and splits into colors when shining through water droplets.
Sunlight + Raindrops = Rainbow!

feedback.success: Colorful science! Sunlight shining through raindrops makes a rainbow!
feedback.retry: Think about what is falling in the air while the sun shines!

challenges.prompt: Start at 8 and climb 7 steps up! Where do you land?
hints: Start at 8 on the number line, then hop 7 steps to the right.
Step by step: 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15! You land on 15!

feedback.success: Excellent! Eight plus seven equals fifteen!
feedback.retry: Not there yet! Hop the steps with me and count out loud!

challenges.prompt: Start at 16 and walk 7 steps down! Where do you land?
hints: Start at 16 on the number line, then hop 7 steps to the left.
Step by step: 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9! You land on 9!

feedback.success: Excellent! Sixteen minus seven equals nine!
feedback.retry: Not there yet! Hop the steps with me and count out loud!

challenges.prompt: Start at 9 and climb 6 steps up! Where do you land?
hints: Start at 9 on the number line, then hop 6 steps to the right.
Step by step: 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15! You land on 15!

feedback.success: Excellent! Nine plus six equals fifteen!
feedback.retry: Not there yet! Hop the steps with me and count out loud!

ilos.text: Apply addition and subtraction with larger numbers on the way up the mountain.
ilos.kidText: I can do big adds and take-aways!

ilos.text: Understand a short science fact and use the numbers inside it to solve.
ilos.kidText: I can use science clues to help me solve!

intro.story: Princess Lexi hid treasure words in the garden. Find them by color and size!
intro.goal: Find the right picture in 3 rounds.

challenges.prompt: What do a fish's gills take from ocean water?

media.subtitle: Reef Words
media.scenario: A fish swims through Ocean Reef using fins to steer and gills to breathe. What gas do gills absorb from water?

hints: Just like our lungs breathe oxygen from air, gills pull it from water.
Fish breathe dissolved oxygen!

feedback.success: Great reef biology! Fish absorb oxygen with their gills!
feedback.retry: Think about what living animals must breathe to survive!

challenges.prompt: Match each ocean creature to its reef adaptation!
hints: Think about each sea creature's special feature.
Fish -> gills, Sea Turtle -> shell, Coral -> reef shelter!

feedback.success: Ocean explorer! Every reef match is complete!
feedback.retry: Match each sea creature with what helps it live on the reef!

challenges.prompt: Why do small reef fish hide among coral branches?

media.subtitle: Tide Pool
media.scenario: Little fish dart into rocky cracks and coral branches whenever bigger shadows pass overhead. Why?

hints: Think about why small fish hide from bigger hungry fish.
Coral gives tiny fish shelter from predators!

feedback.success: Correct! Coral reefs act as safe shelters!
feedback.retry: Choose the ocean survival reason!

challenges.prompt: Find the RED ball!
hints: First find the balls. Then choose the red one!
Step by step: two pictures are balls, two are houses. The ball that looks like fire is the red ball!

feedback.success: Great job! A RED ball! Red ball!
feedback.retry: Not that one! Listen again: find the red ball!

challenges.prompt: Find the BIG tree!
hints: First find the trees. Then choose the bigger one!
Step by step: two pictures are trees. Which tree reaches higher? The big tree!

feedback.success: Great job! A BIG tree! Big tree!
feedback.retry: Not that one! Listen again: find the big tree!

challenges.prompt: Find the SMALL house!
hints: First find the houses. Then choose the smaller one!
Step by step: two pictures are houses. Which house is tiny? The small house!

feedback.success: Great job! A SMALL house! Small house!
feedback.retry: Not that one! Listen again: find the small house!

ilos.text: Identify everyday science words from pictures and clues.
ilos.kidText: I can find science words I know!

ilos.text: Recall the simple science facts met on the journey.
ilos.kidText: I remember the fun facts!

intro.story: A treasure chest is hidden on the map. Follow the directions to find it!
intro.goal: Move the hero on the grid to reach the treasure.

challenges.prompt: Move 3 steps RIGHT, then 3 steps UP to open the park chest!
hints: Tap Right 3 times first.
Now tap Up 3 times to reach (3, 3)!

feedback.success: Awesome navigation! You reached the park treasure!
feedback.retry: Follow the grid coordinates step by step!

challenges.prompt: Where does the Puzzle Park path finish?

media.subtitle: Maze Path
media.scenario: Start at (0, 0). Walk 2 steps North (up) and then 1 step East (right). Which coordinate do you reach?

hints: East changes the first number (x); North changes the second number (y).
x = 1 and y = 2 gives (1, 2)!

feedback.success: Spot on! 1 East and 2 North is (1, 2)!
feedback.retry: Remember (x, y): East is x, North is y!

challenges.prompt: Find the missing step in the repeating compass sequence!

media.subtitle: Arrow Sequence
media.scenario: Look at the repeating loop of directions. What replaces '?'?

hints: The 3-step cycle is UP, RIGHT, DOWN.
After UP and RIGHT comes DOWN!

feedback.success: Pattern solved! DOWN completes the loop!
feedback.retry: Repeat the 3-step cycle: UP, RIGHT, DOWN!

challenges.prompt: Move 2 steps RIGHT, then 1 step UP!
hints: Tap the RIGHT arrow 2 times, then the UP arrow 1 time!
Step by step: right, right... now you are at the right spot. Then up! The treasure is there!

feedback.success: You found the treasure! Great directions!
feedback.retry: Not there yet! Listen to the steps again!

challenges.prompt: Move 3 steps LEFT, then 2 steps DOWN!
hints: Tap the LEFT arrow 3 times, then the DOWN arrow 2 times!
Step by step: left, left, left... then down, down! The treasure is there!

feedback.success: You found the treasure! Great directions!
feedback.retry: Not there yet! Listen to the steps again!

challenges.prompt: Collect 7 keys, then use 2! How many keys are left?
hints: First tap all 7 keys to collect them, then tap 2 keys to use them!
Step by step: collect 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7... use 1... use 2. Count what is left: 5!

feedback.success: Great job! 7 keys, use 2... 5 keys are left!
feedback.retry: Let's count the keys again!

ilos.text: Apply step-by-step directions (left, right, up, down) to reach a target on a grid.
ilos.kidText: I can follow the map steps to the treasure!

ilos.text: Apply counting to answer how many keys or steps the map needs.
ilos.kidText: I can count my keys and steps!

intro.story: The King's royal feast needs exact amounts. Solve it step by step!
intro.goal: Solve 3 two-step problems for the King.

challenges.prompt: Which planet orbits closest to the Sun?

media.subtitle: Solar System
media.scenario: Look at the inner planets lined up outward from the Sun. Which planet sits in the '?' spot?

hints: It is the smallest rocky planet right beside the Sun.
Mercury is the first planet from the Sun!

feedback.success: Blast off! Mercury is closest to the Sun!
feedback.retry: Think of the first planet before Venus and Earth!

challenges.prompt: Match each space object with its description!
hints: Pair each planet or star with its famous trait.
Sun -> Center Star, Mars -> Red Planet, Saturn -> Icy Rings!

feedback.success: Stellar memory! Space pairs locked!
feedback.retry: Remember where each space card sits!

challenges.prompt: Why do astronauts float inside the Space Station?

media.subtitle: Space Science
media.scenario: Astronauts onboard the orbiting Space Station drift weightlessly through the cabin. What explains this?

options: Stars pull them to the roof
hints: Earth's gravity still pulls on the station, keeping it curved in orbit.
The station and astronauts fall together around Earth in free-fall orbit!

feedback.success: Awesome physics! Orbit is continuous free-fall around Earth!
feedback.retry: Think about how an orbiting station moves around Earth!

challenges.prompt: 8 plus 5, then minus 4 — how many?
hints: Do one step at a time: first add, then take away.
Step by step: 8 plus 5 is 13. Then 13 minus 4 is 9!

feedback.success: Amazing! 8 plus 5 is 13, then minus 4 is 9!
feedback.retry: Take your time! Let's do the first step together!

challenges.prompt: 7 plus 6, then minus 3 — how many?
hints: Do one step at a time: first add, then take away.
Step by step: 7 plus 6 is 13. Then 13 minus 3 is 10!

feedback.success: Amazing! 7 plus 6 is 13, then minus 3 is 10!
feedback.retry: Take your time! Let's do the first step together!

challenges.prompt: 12 minus 2, then plus 3 — how many?
hints: Do one step at a time: first take away, then add.
Step by step: 12 minus 2 is 10. Then 10 plus 3 is 13!

feedback.success: Amazing! 12 minus 2 is 10, then plus 3 is 13!
feedback.retry: Take your time! Let's do the first step together!

ilos.text: Deduce the answer to two-step royal missions by chaining two operations.
ilos.kidText: I can do two sums and find the royal answer!

ilos.text: Recall the science facts used in the royal missions.
ilos.kidText: I remember the facts the King asked about!

intro.story: The words in the kingdom lost their order. Put them back to build sentences!
intro.goal: Build 3 sentences in the right order.

challenges.prompt: Notice Maya's feelings and pick the kindest response!

media.subtitle: Feelings
media.scenario: Maya spilled her paint tray by mistake and tears well up in her eyes. How is Maya feeling, and what helps most?

challenges.correctAnswer: Sad - offer to help clean up
options: Sad - offer to help clean up
hints: Tears after a spill show sadness.
Offering a helping hand cheers her up and solves the mess!

feedback.success: Warm heart! Helping a sad friend makes both of you stronger!
feedback.retry: Look at Maya's tears and choose the caring helper response!

challenges.prompt: Which polite response shows gratitude?

media.subtitle: Good Manners
media.scenario: Grandpa hands you a basket of fresh apples he picked especially for you. What do you say?

options: I did not ask for this.
hints: Gratitude means showing appreciation for someone's kindness.
Saying 'Thank you so much!' warms Grandpa's heart!

feedback.success: Wonderful manners! Saying thank you spreads joy!
feedback.retry: Choose the grateful, respectful words!

challenges.prompt: Choose the fairest way to share one ball with four friends!

media.subtitle: Sharing
media.scenario: Four friends arrive at Kindness Corner to play, and there is only one ball. What is the fairest plan?

challenges.correctAnswer: Play a game where everyone takes turns
options: Play a game where everyone takes turns
Keep the ball only for yourself
Hide the ball behind a bush
hints: Fair sharing means nobody gets left out.
Taking turns lets all four friends play together!

feedback.success: Fair and kind! Taking turns makes playtime fun for all!
feedback.retry: Pick the plan where all four friends get to join!

challenges.prompt: Put the words in order: I see a cat!
hints: Say the sentence out loud with Lumo: which word comes first?
Step by step: "I see a cat."!

feedback.success: Wonderful! I see a cat. You built a real sentence!
feedback.retry: Almost! Find the first word of the sentence and build from there!

challenges.prompt: Put the words in order: The ball is red!
hints: Say the sentence out loud with Lumo: which word comes first?
Step by step: "The ball is red."!

feedback.success: Wonderful! The ball is red. You built a real sentence!
feedback.retry: Almost! Find the first word of the sentence and build from there!

challenges.prompt: Put the words in order: The dog can run!
hints: Say the sentence out loud with Lumo: which word comes first?
Step by step: "The dog can run."!

feedback.success: Wonderful! The dog can run. You built a real sentence!
feedback.retry: Almost! Find the first word of the sentence and build from there!

ilos.text: Construct a full sentence by ordering word cards from left to right.
ilos.kidText: I can build a whole sentence!

ilos.text: Choose kind responses when a friend feels sad, frustrated, or left out.
ilos.kidText: I can help a friend who is having a hard feeling.

ilos.text: Recognise the feelings named in the kindness scenarios.
ilos.kidText: I can tell how a friend is feeling!

intro.story: The royal workshop crafts the crown for the Crystal of Knowledge. Sort the items and count!

challenges.prompt: Complete the steps showing how a fossil forms!

media.subtitle: Fossil Lab
media.scenario: Follow how ancient bones or shells become fossils over millions of years:

hints: Minerals harden into stone matching the original outline.
The hardened rock preserves the fossil's shape!

feedback.success: Awesome paleontology! Minerals turn buried remains into stone!

challenges.prompt: What did a flat-toothed Triceratops eat?

media.subtitle: Prehistoric Diet
media.scenario: Fossil skulls show Triceratops had a strong beak and rows of flat grinding teeth. What kind of food was its jaw built for?

hints: Flat grinding teeth mash tough leaves and ferns.
Plant-eating dinosaurs are herbivores!

feedback.success: Spot on! Triceratops was a plant-eating herbivore!
feedback.retry: Compare flat grinding teeth to sharp tearing teeth!

challenges.prompt: Deduce the story told by the Dino Valley trackway!

media.subtitle: Track Deduction
media.scenario: Examine the preserved footprint clues in ancient mudstone:
clues: Two trackways run side by side at the same steady angle.
One trackway has huge prints; the other has smaller prints.
Suddenly, the stride spacing between prints gets much wider.

challenges.correctAnswer: Two dinosaurs walked together and sped up
options: Two dinosaurs walked together and sped up
A giant bird nested in the clouds
Only fern roots grew in the mud
hints: Parallel tracks show two travelers; wider steps show running faster!
A big dinosaur and smaller one walked side by side, then sped up!

feedback.success: Trackway decoded! Wider stride spacing means faster speed!
feedback.retry: Match the parallel tracks and wider steps to the story!

feedback.success: Amazing! 9 items minus 2 = 7! The crown is ready!

intro.story: You did it, hero! The 12 shards are yours. Now face the final challenge and restore the Crystal of Knowledge!

variants.prompt: Solve the mountain number clues!

media.subtitle: Number Detective
media.scenario: Use all three clues to find the secret peak number:
clues: It is an even number between 21 and 29.
Its ones digit is twice its tens digit.
What is the secret number?

hints: Between 21 and 29 means the tens digit is 2.
Twice 2 is 4, so 2 tens and 4 ones makes 24!

feedback.success: Brilliant deduction! 2 tens and 4 ones gives 24!
feedback.retry: Check the tens digit first, then double it for the ones!

variants.prompt: Count 10 coins and 2 more coins!

media.subtitle: Tens and Ones
media.scenario: One full stack has 10 coins, and 2 extra coins sit beside it. How many coins in all?

hints: Start at 10 and count 2 more.
10... 11, 12! There are 12 coins!

feedback.success: Nice job! 10 plus 2 makes 12!
feedback.retry: Count on 2 steps from 10!

variants.prompt: Crack the three-digit place-value code!

media.subtitle: Place Value Code
media.scenario: Deduce the vault code from the mountain clues:
clues: The hundreds digit is 4.
The tens digit is 3 less than the hundreds digit.
All three digits add up to 10.

hints: Subtract 3 from 4 to find the tens digit (1).
Now 4 + 1 + ones = 10, so the ones digit is 5: 415!

feedback.success: Master codebreaker! 415 fits every clue!
feedback.retry: Find the tens digit first (4 - 3), then make the sum equal 10!

hints: Look for the number 12 before the colon.
12:00 means twelve o'clock noon!

feedback.success: Great job! 12:00 is twelve o'clock!
feedback.retry: Check the hour number on the left of the dots!

They rest for 20 minutes at the ridge.
What time do they start climbing again?

hints: 8:15 plus 45 minutes brings them to 9:00.
Add 20 rest minutes to 9:00 to get 9:20!

feedback.success: Exact timing! 8:15 + 45 min + 20 min = 9:20!
feedback.retry: Add 45 minutes to 8:15 first to reach the next hour!
